notes.title: Town of illustive - Special Demo Version 1.2 Release Now a DLC too...
notes.notes:
We have now released Version 1.2 For Town of illustive: Special Demo Version as well released a special

Free DLC to play the demo version of the game if you already owned town of illustive.   Make sure you select "Launch Helper Network Launcher (Beta)" To run the brand new episode launcher.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793747/a2ea1a1936faf8207d9448082ec98a8324ca72aa.png"]


From there you may run the game by pressing the Town of illustive button > SDV > "Play Episode" button on the Helper Network Service Launcher

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793747/db966aa175de2058ad7033a864eee6c03eebcd24.png"]
Version 1.2 
[olist]
Changes to puzzles graphics and text to make puzzler easier to understand.

Changes to some maps looks. No changes to layout of current maps designs.

inclusion of pre-rendered 3D introduction character models that have been designed for the future helper franchise.

further improvements of dialogue and scenes.

Replacement of the current episodic launcher with a more powerful Launcher dubbed The "Helper Network Service" a platform independent and friendly launcher for all Future Helper series games. 
[/olist]

notes.title: 1.2 Improvements update
notes.notes:
As part of the major changes to the current storywriting improvements of town of illustive as well introducing to the world of the future helper series, we are updating and releasing a new version including graphical and important bug fixes on both the demo version and episode 1 prior to Episode 2 release.



As well the retiring the old Episodic launcher software in favor for a newer and sleeker Platform Friendly Launcher.



Planned changes:
[olist]
Changes to puzzles graphics and text to make puzzler easier to understand.

Changes to some maps looks. No changes to layout of current maps designs.

inclusion of pre-rendered 3D introduction character models that have been designed for the future helper franchise.

further improvements of dialogue and scenes.

Replacement of the current episodic launcher with a more powerful Launcher dubbed The "Helper Network Service" a platform independent and friendly launcher for all Future Helper series games.
[/olist]
We would like to thank to all of our players for being part of the community

notes.notes:

were apologized for the inconvenience. but rest assured the fixes have been tested prior to the update.
